## Purpose

Harmony parsers currently ignore OpenAI `type: refusal` content parts and only read `text`. A part like `{"type": "refusal", "refusal": "I can't help with that"}` is therefore converted to empty `TextContent`, so the model never sees the refusal string.

This maps refusal parts to Harmony `TextContent` using `refusal` with a fallback to `text`, matching Chat Completions / `chat_utils` / Cohere conventions. No new Harmony channel is introduced. Other non-text types are left unchanged.

Fixed sites:
- `parse_chat_input_to_harmony_message` in `vllm/entrypoints/openai/parser/harmony_utils.py`
- `_parse_harmony_format_message` and `_parse_chat_format_message` in `vllm/entrypoints/openai/responses/harmony.py`

## Why this is not a duplicate

Checked open PRs for "harmony refusal" / "refusal content". Nearby work is different:

- #49130 / #48237 reconstruct Responses *output* items and crash on empty/refusal `ResponseOutputRefusal` blocks in `responses/utils.py`.
- #28303 (closed) recovered malformed gpt-oss *model output* with newer `openai-harmony`.

None of those map inbound OpenAI refusal content parts onto Harmony `TextContent`.

## Test Plan

CPU-only unit tests; no `gpt-oss-20b` download.

```
pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/parser/test_harmony_utils.py tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_harmony_utils.py -v --tb=short
```

Coverage:
- Chat-format assistant message with `[{"type":"refusal","refusal":"I can't help with that"}]` keeps that string (not empty).
- Mixed text + refusal parts.
- Refusal part that only has a `text` field.
- Chat Completions assistant refusal goes to the `final` channel.
- Responses Harmony-format messages via `response_previous_input_to_harmony`.

## Test Result

```
193 passed in 4.09s
```

All new refusal tests pass; existing harmony parser/Responses unit tests still pass. `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` are clean on the four changed files.

## AI assistance

AI assistance was used to implement and write tests. A human reviewed every changed line and ran the tests above.

Resolved the merge conflict against current `main`.

The only conflict was in `tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_harmony_utils.py`, where this PR and #55701 both added tests at the same location. Both sets are kept:

- this PR's refusal-content mapping tests
- `test_chat_message_without_role_raises_validation_error` from #55701

The `text_from_content_part` helper and its call sites auto-merged cleanly with the `VLLMValidationError` changes from #50257 / #55701.

Local check: `tests/entrypoints/openai/parser/test_harmony_utils.py` + `tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_harmony_utils.py` — 194 passed.
Synced this branch onto current `main` (`756794a9a`). Merge was clean; Harmony refusal mapping is unchanged. Local: `test_harmony_utils.py` parser + responses — 195 passed.

Follow-up from a second-pass review of the remaining Harmony input paths.

`response_input_to_harmony` (Responses `request.input`) still used `c.get("text")` for list content, so a replayed OpenAI refusal part became empty Harmony text. That path now uses `text_from_content_part`, with tests in `test_response_input_to_harmony.py`.

Local: refusal + `response_input_to_harmony` message tests — 68 passed.

Follow-up on this branch (`cbba7333d`): chat-format Responses replay (`_parse_chat_format_message` / `previous_input_messages`) now matches Chat Completions for assistant turns.

- assistant + `tool_calls` keeps non-empty content as `commentary` and `reasoning` as `analysis` before the function calls
- assistant without tools tags non-empty content as `channel=final` and omits empty content
- refusal parts still go through `text_from_content_part`

Local: `tests/entrypoints/openai/parser/test_harmony_utils.py` + `tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_harmony_utils.py` + `tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_response_input_to_harmony.py` — **220 passed**.

Follow-up (`8ccfbc0d9`): assistant + `tool_calls` still flattened content with `item.get("text")`, so a `type: refusal` part next to tool calls was dropped. `flatten_input_text_content` now keeps those refusal strings. Also emit the assistant `final` message if a later part has text even when the first part is empty.

Local: parser + responses harmony tests — **226 passed**.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

APPROVE — verified locally against head 8e1b7c29 and base 28e605fb.

**Bug is real.** OpenAI refusal content parts (`{"type": "refusal", "refusal": "..."}`) were flattened with `c.get("text", "")` in the Harmony parsing paths, silently dropping the refusal string into an empty TextContent — the model never saw it (and an all-refusal message could collapse to an empty assistant turn).

**Fix verified.** New `text_from_content_part()` helper: refusal parts read `refusal` first, then fall back to `text` (the variant some producers emit), else `""`; non-refusal parts unchanged (`text` or `""`). Applied at all three content-list flattening sites: `parse_chat_input_to_harmony_message` (parser/harmony_utils.py), `_parse_harmony_format_message` and `_parse_chat_format_message` (responses/harmony.py). Ordering preserved — a mixed text+refusal array keeps both parts in sequence (asserted).

**Regression-proven:** 7/7 new tests FAIL on base 28e605fb (refusal dropped to empty text; mixed arrays lose the refusal part) / all PASS at head. The one new test that passes on both (`test_refusal_content_falls_back_to_text_field`) is a behavior-preservation lock — a refusal carrying `text` instead of `refusal` already worked pre-fix, and the helper keeps that working — correct to keep. Full touched test files: 193 passed at head vs 186 on base — the +7 are exactly the new tests; zero collateral.

**Non-blocking observation (sibling site):** `response_input_to_harmony` (responses/harmony.py:171) still flattens list content with `c.get("text", "")` for non-system/developer `type: message` input items. In practice that path serves Responses `input` items whose validated content parts are text/image/audio (`refusal` is an output-only construct per the OpenAI schema), so it is likely unreachable for refusals today — but for defense-in-depth and consistency, routing it through `text_from_content_part` too would close the class entirely. Not a blocker; worth a follow-up commit.

Otherwise clean, minimal, well-tested.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

APPROVE — verified locally against head 8e1b7c29 and base 28e605fb.

**Bug is real.** OpenAI refusal content parts (`{"type": "refusal", "refusal": "..."}`) were flattened with `c.get("text", "")` in the Harmony parsing paths, silently dropping the refusal string into an empty TextContent — the model never saw it (and an all-refusal message could collapse to an empty assistant turn).

**Fix verified.** New `text_from_content_part()` helper: refusal parts read `refusal` first, then fall back to `text` (the variant some producers emit), else `""`; non-refusal parts unchanged (`text` or `""`). Applied at all three content-list flattening sites: `parse_chat_input_to_harmony_message` (parser/harmony_utils.py), `_parse_harmony_format_message` and `_parse_chat_format_message` (responses/harmony.py). Ordering preserved — a mixed text+refusal array keeps both parts in sequence (asserted).

**Regression-proven:** 7/7 new tests FAIL on base 28e605fb (refusal dropped to empty text; mixed arrays lose the refusal part) / all PASS at head. The one new test that passes on both (`test_refusal_content_falls_back_to_text_field`) is a behavior-preservation lock — a refusal carrying `text` instead of `refusal` already worked pre-fix, and the helper keeps that working — correct to keep. Full touched test files: 193 passed at head vs 186 on base — the +7 are exactly the new tests; zero collateral.

**Non-blocking observation (sibling site):** `response_input_to_harmony` (responses/harmony.py:171) still flattens list content with `c.get("text", "")` for non-system/developer `type: message` input items. In practice that path serves Responses `input` items whose validated content parts are text/image/audio (`refusal` is an output-only construct per the OpenAI schema), so it is likely unreachable for refusals today — but for defense-in-depth and consistency, routing it through `text_from_content_part` too would close the class entirely. Not a blocker; worth a follow-up commit.

Otherwise clean, minimal, well-tested.
